title: Story-start standing pressures
scope: Qualitative configuration of the standing, unresolved pressures shaping the initial settlement and its region at story start; usable for politics, daily life, culture, and story development without establishing any occurred event, named party, timeline, escalation, institution, species presence, or resolution.
claims: At story start, five standing pressure classes are simultaneously live in the settlement and its region, and none is resolved: approaching-first-succession political pressure, returning-peoples external pressure, seasonal ecological strain, cross-lake trade rivalry with the imperial-remnant industrial settlement, and returning dangerous wildlife.

The first succession of the founder's rule is approaching, and the rules that would govern it remain incompletely settled, per WLD-CULTURE-002's designed succession ambiguity, which that record alone defines.

Returning non-human peoples are a real regional phenomenon consistent with the displacement-and-return history WLD-HISTORY-001 records; at story start they are known at the settlement only through reported-only accounts, transient signs attested at a regional distance, and imported objects of uncertain provenance, per WLD-ECOLOGY-005's provenance classes, with no direct presence or contact at or near the settlement.

Seasonal ecological strain is a standing condition at story start: stores sit lower than customary comfort and subsistence planning is under visible adjustment, arising only through accepted mechanisms — corridor disruption and crop exposure per WLD-ECOLOGY-004, pulse-mosaic variability per WLD-ECOLOGY-005, and lake seasonal variation within WLD-ECOLOGY-006's bounds.

Cross-lake tensions and trade rivalry stand between the settlement and the imperial-remnant industrial settlement WLD-LOCATION-005 records; at story start this rivalry audibly organises settlement politics and colours how the approaching succession is argued.

The rivalry's qualitative forms can include contested exchange terms, intermittent embargo-like interruptions of exchange, and competitive claims of standing; each is a standing tension or tendency, and none is an occurred incident, negotiation, or conflict event.

Returning dangerous wildlife is a felt standing pressure class: recovering megafauna per the accepted corridor and pulse records (WLD-ECOLOGY-004, WLD-ECOLOGY-005, WLD-ECOLOGY-006), together with qualitative predator and raider classes — large pack predators, large solitary predators, uncanny solitary humanoid-reading predators, and raiding bands of the pest-like pack species whose collapse-era spread WLD-HISTORY-001 records.

Under the selected rivalry-forward configuration, returning-peoples reports and seasonal strain build in the background: real and unresolved while receiving less public deliberation than the rivalry at story start.
boundaries: This record is a forward extension establishing standing story-start pressures only; it does not alter the settlement, compact, regional history, ecology, locations, or travel anchors of any accepted record, and every open boundary of the cited records remains open.

Standing pressure, salience, rivalry-forward, audibly organises, colours, felt, background, customary comfort, visible adjustment, contested exchange terms, embargo-like interruption, competitive claims of standing, predator class, and raider class are qualitative author-facing descriptions; they fix no in-world term, name, measurement, calendar, schedule, frequency, doctrine, or institution.

Every claim in this record is a standing state or tendency at story start; no plot event, occurred story event, incident, negotiation, embargo, contact, sighting, attack, crisis in progress, resolution, or outcome is established as having happened.

No future war, control-assertion, escalation, timeline, or inevitability claim is established; series plot intent is staged outside setting canon, and this record does not establish any trajectory as occurring or inevitable.

WLD-CULTURE-002 remains the sole authority for the compact's structure, offices, decision classes, representation, and designed succession ambiguity; this record adds no succession rule, process, candidate, contender, heir, faction roster, or outcome, and does not narrow or resolve the ambiguity.

Particular returning peoples, their identities, numbers, locations, histories, aims, languages, and relations remain undefined; no people is characterised as hostile, friendly, unified, or coordinated, and returning peoples are not flattened into a single invading category.

Per WLD-ECOLOGY-005's non-transfer rules, no report, transient sign, or imported object establishes direct presence, range, aims, or population; no presence, sighting, or contact at or near the settlement, its worked land, roads, or shore access is established, and whether particular reports are accurate remains undefined.

No famine, shortage event, occurred disaster, recruitment failure, or System cause stands behind the seasonal strain; the strain arises only through the cited weather, corridor, and pulse mechanisms, and its exact weather sequence, severity, and regional extent remain undefined.

WLD-ECOLOGY-006's harvest boundary remains intact: no harvest technique, rate, institution, law, ownership, preservation method, or trade practice is established, and store accounting, storage arrangements, rationing customs, and any allocation authority remain undefined.

WLD-LOCATION-005 remains the sole authority for the imperial-remnant industrial settlement; this record adds no claim about its interior, works, population, government, or capability, and establishes no route, distance, travel time, market, currency, price, treaty, tariff, law, envoy, official, delegation, institution, or trade-good list between the settlements.

Contested exchange terms, embargo-like interruptions, and competitive claims of standing are possible qualitative forms, not occurred events, counts, schedules, or frequencies; no particular exchange, interruption, claim, insult, or response is established.

The listed predator and raider classes are qualitative pressure classes only; the Author's words 'hags, goblins, mega-fauna, wolves, bears (our world equivalents)' are author-facing shorthand and never in-world taxonomy, no Earth creature exists in the setting, species identity, taxonomy, biology, body plan, abilities, behaviour, ecology, range, and population remain undefined, and no specific creature is established as present at or near the settlement.

The pest-like pack species remains parked; beyond the collapse-era spread WLD-HISTORY-001 records and its qualitative appearance here as a raider pressure class, it gains no biology, culture, language, ability, organisation, or presence development.
No watch, levy, patrol, stockpile standard, defensive measure, office, policy, or institution is established by any pressure.

The pressure configuration is author-side setting truth; a character knows any pressure, report, term of exchange, or wildlife class only through an available source, no appraisal, report, or rumour is omniscient, and report fallibility is a records-and-belief-layer property, not a mechanic.

Natural System behaviour and belief remain separate: no pressure has a System cause, any System-facing interpretation of a pressure by any culture or profession is belief rather than established System behaviour, and no System event, spawning, reset, mechanic, or CAL0 change is established.
No name, date, calendar, unit, map, measurement, or quantitative geography is established; the wider region remains qualitative.
This record adopts no WLD-SOUL, WLD-PRENATAL, or other project default.
story_implications: Scenes, politics, and council business can draw on five standing pressures from the first chapter, while every actual incident, negotiation, contact, sighting, shortage event, and escalation requires its own evidence.
The rivalry-forward salience lets cross-lake politics colour succession argument without deciding either question.
Background pressures can surface unevenly by household, profession, and occasion without any fixed ranking or schedule.
Characters know any pressure only through available sources; reports and rumours can be incomplete or wrong.
system_implications: The selected configuration is an ordinary setting extension under CAL0 SOC1.2D, UI1.2D, and WLD2.2D, not a System change; pressures arise from weather, ecology, politics, and finite attention, never System events.
No institution gains System-granted power, no appraisal or report is omniscient, and report fallibility is a belief-layer property, not a mechanic.
No System event, spawning, reset, mechanic, free resource, or CAL0 change is established.
research_questions: Which non-human people or peoples the circulating reports concern, their identities, aims, and relations, and whether any reports are wrong?
What provenance, accuracy, and transmission chains lie behind specific accounts, transient signs, and imported objects, and what tale-lore builds on them?
What exact weather sequence, corridor disruptions, and pulse shortfalls compose the standing strain, and how severe and widespread is it relative to other years?
What store accounting, storage, rationing, and allocation practices exist, if any, and under whose authority?
What qualitative forms does the cross-lake rivalry take in particular seasons and trades, and how does exchange between the settlements physically move?
Which wildlife pressure classes do later records develop into species, where, with what ecology, and whether any is present near the settlement?
How do different cultures and professions interpret each pressure, including System-facing beliefs about any of them?
Whether, when, and how any pressure escalates, resolves, couples further, or reaches the settlement — series-contract territory?
What in-world names, dates, calendars, and units touch any pressure?

author_approval.evidence: On 2026-08-17 the Author selected an amended custom option through the explicit multiple-choice review: rivalry-forward salience with five standing pressure classes, all present and none resolved.
